test_clear_series_parametric: test the pl.Series.clear method to verify it returns an empty series preserving dtype and name
test_clear_series_n_parametric: test the pl.Series.clear(n) method to verify it returns a series of n nulls preserving dtype and name
test_clear_df: test the pl.DataFrame.clear method to verify it returns an empty dataframe preserving schema and null rows for n>0
test_clear_lf: test the pl.LazyFrame.clear method to verify it returns a cleared lazyframe preserving schema after collect
test_clear_raise_conditions: test that pl.Series.clear and pl.DataFrame.clear raise ValueError for negative n and TypeError for non-integer n
